name: Middleton Farms Pumpkin Patch
address: 21500 Otis Cooper Rd, Moss Point, MS 39562, USA
admission_price: Pre-sale tickets $10 per person, $12 at gate; children 2 and under free
activities: pumpkin patch tour; garden of gourds tour; corn tour; sunflowers tour; fall photos with photo props; pet baby calves; kiddie-train ride; zip line; tractor-pulled ride; live cow milking demonstration; bottle feed a baby calf; make butter; pony rides
season_dates: October 3rd (Harvest Moon Pageant only, rescheduled to October 17th), October 10-11, 17-18, and 24-25 (open to public Saturday/Sunday)
extra_notes: Reservations recommended for faster entry on public weekend dates. Food, pony rides ($5 additional), and gifts available for additional charge. Pets not allowed. Online tickets available daily. Cash only for chaperones at field trips.

name: Williams Family Farms
admission_price: $12 per person, ages 2 and up. Guests aged under 2 are Free.
activities: maze; kids maze; hayride to U-Pick pumpkin patch; animal barnyard; farm playground; cow train rides; jump pillow; gem mining; pumpkin picking; food concessions
season_dates: October 3, 2026 through November 1, 2026. Saturdays 10am-6pm, Sundays 1pm-5pm. Weekdays by appointment only.
extra_notes: FREE parking. Last admission tickets sold one hour before closing. Last hayride departs 5:30pm Saturday/4:30pm Sunday. No entry to U-Pick pumpkin patch after dusk; playground closes at dusk. Pumpkins start at $7. No outside food/drink allowed (exceptions for firepit/birthday reservations). No pets allowed, including service dogs without prior management arrangements. Flashlight required for night maze entry. Strollers and wagons permitted but ground is unpaved and may be uneven. Handicap accessible restrooms and porta potties available. Baby care building with changing table and hand washing station near General Store. No refunds or rain checks for weather closings. Weekdays reserved for school groups/field trips.
